### Casper & the Captain
"No!"

Leo refrained from rejoicing.

"But—" meowed Leo determinedly.

"I said no. Go home, Leo. You shouldn't be out here. It's dangerous!" hissed Casper.

"Captain Leo the Relentless does not take 'no' for an answer!" trilled Skippy.

"He most certainly does not!"

"Yeah, right, he doesn't, yeah!"

"Course he don't! Course he don't!"

"Well, he has been known, on occasion, if we're being honest—"

"Be nice, Loki! No wonder nobody likes you!"

"We never even met before today, how dare you—"

"MEOW!" howled Casper.

From here, reader, the captain himself will need to give the go-ahead for you to read my translation of that howling meow. I don't have the authority. Captain's orders. You'll find him in his quarters, deep beneath the flotsam and jetsam of the southern strand.

Good luck.

Chapter Two: Lady of the Night

An imposing yet shapely form appeared from the darkness. Lady Jan, the mysterious billionaire and notorious genius responsible for far more than her share of the nation's prosperity, stood before its two most dangerous gang leaders. It's said the combined power in the room at this moment could sustain that very nation for a lifetime. 

"Lady Jan? No... I can explain!" stammered Tantra, but her branches wilted beneath the weight of the situation in which she found herself.  

"What is she doing here?" The ecstasy that lit Chal-Moo's loins mere moments ago had just been stamped cold by the intrusion of Jan, his most detested enemy. Now, the remnants of passion's ash smoldered within him, combusting into a blaze of fury.  

"I believe you have something of mine," said Jan, wrapping a possessive hand around Tantra's trunk.

"Mine?" retorted Chal-Moo. "I believe you mean 'ours.'" And he reached for a bottle of rice wine, setting aside three thirsting glasses.

*Q31844 - DBC_Full*

### Report from Lead Engineer Kam-Bo

___

**Summary:** Lady Joon, Project Horizon is currently operating at 23 percent above projections in both energy output and efficiency. Since your recommendation to use our proprietary refined jadeite as the energy-catalyzing medium, Xunlai Jade has seen unprecedented increases in the transference of the subject's essence.

The subject remains enclosed within the Yong Reactor in relative comfort and security, observed and monitored closely by Indigo-Clearance-level staff. All staff have been fully briefed on the new security procedures as ordered by Captain Fa, and the engineers have been duly warned against communicating with the subject in any way, or face immediate termination.

Nahpui Lab reports that jadeite refinement output has increased to meet demand for jade tech in the consumer market, and Municipal Power Plant Zero One has recently converted their facility to use imbued jade tech batteries, bringing the New Kaineng City power supply fully into the modern age.

The subject's essence seems remarkably suited to the refined jadeite acquired from the Jade Sea, as noted in the first quarter operational report. Research is ongoing into the nature of this correlation: early indications suggest the latent magic imbued in the mineral's composition—due to the tremendous release of arcane energy in the catastrophic event colloquially referred to as the "Jade Wind"—may play a role. Further investigation is warranted.

___

Lead Engineer Kam-Bo
